绿茶 (lǜchá) - green tea
水果 (shuǐguǒ) - fruit
红茶 (hóngchá) - black tea (literally red tea)
服务员 (fúwùyuán) - waiter, waitress, attendant
角 (jiǎo) - unit of money (1角 = 0.1元)
分 (fēn) - unit of money (1分 = 0.01元)
小红 (Xiǎohóng) - name of a person mentioned in the text
汉字 Word Game: 外边＋出去→外出
汉字 Word Game: 中午＋睡觉→午觉
汉字 Word Game: 上边＋前面→上面
Note: 2.99元 can be written as 2元9角(jiǎo)9分(fēn); 1角=0.1元, 1分=0.01元
Grammar: V+来/去 with a place object (the place-noun object goes before 来/去, e.g. 下楼来, 回家去)
Grammar: V+来/去 with a thing object (the object may go before or after 来/去, e.g. 带作业来 / 买来点儿面包)
Grammar: V₁了……就V₂…… with two subjects (the second subject goes right before 就)
Grammar: Only 还是 (not 或者) is used in a clause with interrogative form (e.g. 我不知道这个人是男的还是女的)
Grammar: Negative of existence structure: Location Word＋没V着＋NP (no measure word before NP)
Dialogue 1: 下山的路上 (On the way going down the mountain)
休息一下吧。 (Xiūxi yíxià ba.) - Let's take a rest.
怎么了？ (Zěnme le?) - What's the matter?
我现在腿也疼，脚也疼。 (Wǒ xiànzài tuǐ yě téng, jiǎo yě téng.) - Right now my legs hurt and my feet hurt too.
好，那边树多，我们过去坐一下吧。 (Hǎo, nàbian shù duō, wǒmen guòqu zuò yíxià ba.) - OK, there are lots of trees over there; let's go over and sit for a while.
上来的时候我怎么没觉得这么累？ (Shànglai de shíhou wǒ zěnme méi juéde zhème lèi?) - When we were coming up, why didn't I feel this tired?
上山容易下山难，你不知道？ (Shàng shān róngyì xià shān nán, nǐ bù zhīdào?) - Going up the mountain is easy but going down is hard - don't you know that?
Dialogue 2: 在打电话 (On the phone)
喂，你好，请问周明在吗？ (Wèi, nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn Zhōu Míng zài ma?) - Hello, may I ask whether Zhou Ming is in?
周经理出去了，不在办公室。 (Zhōu jīnglǐ chūqu le, bú zài bàngōngshì.) - Manager Zhou has gone out; he is not in the office.
他去哪儿了？ (Tā qù nǎr le?) - Where has he gone?
什么时候回来？ (Shénme shíhou huílai?) - When will he come back?
他出去办事了，下午回来。 (Tā chūqu bàn shì le, xiàwǔ huílai.) - He has gone out on business and will be back in the afternoon.
回来了就让他给我打个电话。 (Huílai le jiù ràng tā gěi wǒ dǎ ge diànhuà.) - As soon as he is back, have him give me a call.
好的，他到了办公室我就告诉他。 (Hǎo de, tā dàole bàngōngshì wǒ jiù gàosu tā.) - OK, as soon as he gets to the office I will tell him.
Dialogue 3: 在楼门口送朋友 (Parting at the exit of the building)
雨下得真大。 (Yǔ xià de zhēn dà.) - The rain is really heavy.
你怎么回去？ (Nǐ zěnme huíqu?) - How will you get back?
我送你吧。 (Wǒ sòng nǐ ba.) - Let me see you off.
没事，我出去叫辆出租车就行了。 (Méi shì, wǒ chūqu jiào liàng chūzūchē jiù xíng le.) - It's fine, I'll go out and call a taxi, and that will do.
那你等等，我上楼去给你拿把伞。 (Nà nǐ děngdeng, wǒ shàng lóu qù gěi nǐ ná bǎ sǎn.) - Then wait a moment; I'll go upstairs to fetch you an umbrella.
我跟你一起上去吧。 (Wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ shàngqu ba.) - I'll go up with you.
你在这儿等吧，我拿了伞就下来。 (Nǐ zài zhèr děng ba, wǒ nále sǎn jiù xiàlai.) - You wait here; I'll come down as soon as I've got the umbrella.
Dialogue 4: 在家 (At home)
你看，我这么胖，怎么办呢？ (Nǐ kàn, wǒ zhème pàng, zěnme bàn ne?) - Look, I'm so fat; what should I do?

你每天晚上吃了饭就睡觉，也不出去走走，能不胖吗？ (Nǐ měi tiān wǎnshang chīle fàn jiù shuì jiào, yě bù chūqu zǒuzou, néng bú pàng ma?) - Every evening you go to sleep as soon as you've eaten and don't go out for a walk either - how could you not be fat?
其实我每天都运动。 (Qíshí wǒ měi tiān dōu yùndòng.) - Actually I exercise every day.
但是你一点儿也没瘦！ (Dànshì nǐ yìdiǎnr yě méi shòu!) - But you haven't become thin at all!
你做什么运动了？ (Nǐ zuò shénme yùndòng le?) - What exercise did you do?
做饭啊。 (Zuò fàn a.) - Cooking!
我们在楼上等你呢，你上来吧。 (Wǒmen zài lóu shàng děng nǐ ne, nǐ shànglai ba.) - We are waiting for you upstairs; come on up.
谁在外边？ (Shéi zài wàibian?) - Who is outside?
你出去看看吧。 (Nǐ chūqu kànkan ba.) - Go out and take a look.
汉语书你带来了吗？ (Hànyǔ shū nǐ dàilai le ma?) - Have you brought the Chinese book?
那边树多，我们过去坐一下吧。 (Nàbian shù duō, wǒmen guòqu zuò yíxià ba.) - There are lots of trees over there; let's go over and sit for a while.
小狗下楼来吃东西。 (Xiǎo gǒu xià lóu lái chī dōngxi.) - The puppy comes downstairs to eat.
老师进教室来上课。 (Lǎoshī jìn jiàoshì lái shàng kè.) - The teacher comes into the classroom to teach.
朋友回家去了。 (Péngyou huí jiā qù le.) - My friend has gone home.
我上楼去。 (Wǒ shàng lóu qù.) - I am going upstairs.
明天要带作业来。 (Míngtiān yào dài zuòyè lái.) - Bring your homework tomorrow.
帮我买来点儿面包。 (Bāng wǒ mǎilai diǎnr miànbāo.) - Buy me some bread.
你搬这把椅子去吧。 (Nǐ bān zhè bǎ yǐzi qù ba.) - Carry this chair over there.
这次旅游，我想带去这本书。 (Zhè cì lǚyóu, wǒ xiǎng dàiqu zhè běn shū.) - On this trip I want to take this book.
我下了课就吃饭。 (Wǒ xiàle kè jiù chī fàn.) - I eat as soon as class is over.
妈妈起了床就做早饭。 (Māma qǐle chuáng jiù zuò zǎofàn.) - Mom makes breakfast as soon as she gets up.
小刚拿了伞就下来。 (Xiǎogāng nále sǎn jiù xiàlai.) - Xiaogang comes down as soon as he has taken the umbrella.
你每天晚上吃了饭就睡觉。 (Nǐ měi tiān wǎnshang chīle fàn jiù shuì jiào.) - Every evening you go to sleep as soon as you've eaten.
你下了课我们就去书店。 (Nǐ xiàle kè wǒmen jiù qù shūdiàn.) - As soon as you finish class we will go to the bookstore.
老师进了教室我们就对她说“生日快乐”。 (Lǎoshī jìnle jiàoshì wǒmen jiù duì tā shuō “shēngrì kuàilè”.) - As soon as the teacher enters the classroom we say "Happy birthday" to her.
爸爸回来了我们就吃饭。 (Bàba huílai le wǒmen jiù chī fàn.) - We eat as soon as Dad comes back.
他到了办公室我就告诉他。 (Tā dàole bàngōngshì wǒ jiù gàosu tā.) - As soon as he gets to the office I will tell him.
你什么时候给妈妈打电话？ (Nǐ shénme shíhou gěi māma dǎ diànhuà?) - When will you call your mom?
你什么时候走？ (Nǐ shénme shíhou zǒu?) - When are you leaving?
为什么我的汉语学得不好？ (Wèishénme wǒ de Hànyǔ xué de bù hǎo?) - Why is my Chinese not good?
你不做作业，也不练习，能学好吗？ (Nǐ bú zuò zuòyè, yě bù liànxí, néng xuéhǎo ma?) - You don't do homework and you don't practise - how could you learn it well? (meaning: you can't)
你看我这么胖，怎么办呢？ (Nǐ kàn wǒ zhème pàng, zěnme bàn ne?) - Look how fat I am; what should I do?

你每天晚上吃了饭就睡觉，也不出去走走，能不胖吗？ (Nǐ měi tiān wǎnshang chīle fàn jiù shuì jiào, yě bù chūqu zǒuzou, néng bú pàng ma?) - You go to sleep as soon as you've eaten every evening and don't go out for a walk - how could you not be fat? (meaning: you will be fat)
上山容易下山难。 (Shàng shān róngyì xià shān nán.) - Going up the mountain is easy, going down is hard.
我上楼去给你拿把伞。 (Wǒ shàng lóu qù gěi nǐ ná bǎ sǎn.) - I'll go upstairs to fetch an umbrella for you.
你一点儿也没瘦。 (Nǐ yìdiǎnr yě méi shòu.) - You haven't become thin at all.
我现在腿也疼，脚也疼。 (Wǒ xiànzài tuǐ yě téng, jiǎo yě téng.) - Right now my legs hurt and my feet hurt too.
我拿了伞就下来。 (Wǒ nále sǎn jiù xiàlai.) - I'll come down as soon as I've taken the umbrella.
我怎么这么累啊？ (Wǒ zěnme zhème lèi a?) - Why am I so tired?
我病了，头疼。 (Wǒ bìng le, tóu téng.) - I'm ill; I have a headache.
你怎么打篮球打得这么好？ (Nǐ zěnme dǎ lánqiú dǎ de zhème hǎo?) - How come you play basketball so well?
你真爱看书，买了这么多！ (Nǐ zhēn ài kàn shū, mǎile zhème duō!) - You really love reading - you've bought so many!
我想买这辆车。 (Wǒ xiǎng mǎi zhè liàng chē.) - I want to buy this car.
太贵了，你有那么多钱吗？ (Tài guì le, nǐ yǒu nàme duō qián ma?) - It's too expensive; do you have that much money?
下雨了！我没带伞，怎么办？ (Xià yǔ le! Wǒ méi dài sǎn, zěnme bàn?) - It's raining! I didn't bring an umbrella; what should I do?
昨天走路走得太多了，左边这条腿有点儿疼。 (Zuótiān zǒulù zǒu de tài duō le, zuǒbian zhè tiáo tuǐ yǒudiǎnr téng.) - I walked too much yesterday; this left leg hurts a bit.
那你今天别出去了。 (Nà nǐ jīntiān bié chūqu le.) - Then don't go out today.
今天不行，今天有很多工作要做。 (Jīntiān bù xíng, jīntiān yǒu hěn duō gōngzuò yào zuò.) - Today is not possible; there is a lot of work to do today.
他回家以后也工作吗？ (Tā huí jiā yǐhòu yě gōngzuò ma?) - Does he work after he gets home too?
哥哥去哪儿了？ (Gēge qù nǎr le?) - Where has my elder brother gone?
他什么时候回来？ (Tā shénme shíhou huílai?) - When will he come back?
那我进去等你们。 (Nà wǒ jìnqu děng nǐmen.) - Then I'll go in and wait for you.
我去运动。 (Wǒ qù yùndòng.) - I'm going to exercise.
你现在没以前那么胖了。 (Nǐ xiànzài méi yǐqián nàme pàng le.) - You're not as fat now as before.
小丽现在怎么了？ (Xiǎolì xiànzài zěnme le?) - What is wrong with Xiaoli now?
周经理去哪儿了？ (Zhōu jīnglǐ qù nǎr le?) - Where has Manager Zhou gone?
什么时候回来？ (Shénme shíhou huílai?) - When will he come back?
小丽怎么回去？ (Xiǎolì zěnme huíqu?) - How will Xiaoli get back?
小刚上楼去做什么？ (Xiǎogāng shàng lóu qù zuò shénme?) - What is Xiaogang going upstairs to do?
周太太为什么这么胖？ (Zhōu tàitai wèishénme zhème pàng?) - Why is Mrs. Zhou so fat?
周太太每天做运动吗？ (Zhōu tàitai měi tiān zuò yùndòng ma?) - Does Mrs. Zhou exercise every day?
你们家谁最忙？ (Nǐmen jiā shéi zuì máng?) - Who is the busiest in your family?
我们家我最忙。 (Wǒmen jiā wǒ zuì máng.) - In our family I am the busiest.
你每天做什么事？ (Nǐ měi tiān zuò shénme shì?) - What do you do every day?
我每天早上起了床就吃饭，吃了饭就去上课…… (Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qǐle chuáng jiù chī fàn, chīle fàn jiù qù shàng kè……) - Every morning as soon as I get up I eat, and as soon as I've eaten I go to class...
饭后百步走，活到九十九。 (Fàn hòu bǎi bù zǒu, huódào jiǔshíjiǔ.) - A walk after dinner makes one live to 99.

这句话字面的意思是吃完饭以后要走一百步，这样可以活到九十九岁。 (Zhè jù huà zìmiàn de yìsi shì chī wán fàn yǐhòu yào zǒu yìbǎi bù, zhèyàng kěyǐ huódào jiǔshíjiǔ suì.) - The literal meaning of this saying is that after eating one should walk a hundred steps, and in this way one can live to 99 years old.

现在人们常用这句话说明，吃饭以后要运动运动，身体才能健康。 (Xiànzài rénmen cháng yòng zhè jù huà shuōmíng, chī fàn yǐhòu yào yùndòng yùndòng, shēntǐ cái néng jiànkāng.) - Now people often use this saying to explain that after a meal one should exercise a little so that the body can be healthy.
桌子上放着很多饮料。 (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào.) - There are plenty of drinks on the table.
Dialogue 1: 在小丽家 (At Xiaoli's home)
明天是晴天还是阴天？ (Míngtiān shì qíngtiān háishi yīntiān?) - Will tomorrow be sunny or cloudy?
阴天，电视上说多云。 (Yīntiān, diànshì shang shuō duōyún.) - Cloudy; the TV says it will be partly cloudy.
怎么了？ (Zěnme le?) - What's the matter?
有事？ (Yǒu shì?) - Is something up?
没事，我们明天要去爬山。 (Méi shì, wǒmen míngtiān yào qù pá shān.) - Nothing; we are going to climb a mountain tomorrow.
爬山的时候要小心点儿。 (Pá shān de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn diǎnr.) - Be a bit careful when you climb the mountain.
好，你也去吗？ (Hǎo, nǐ yě qù ma?) - OK, are you going too?
我不去，我有事。 (Wǒ bú qù, wǒ yǒu shì.) - I'm not going; I have something to do.
Dialogue 2: 在商场 (In a mall)
你觉得这条裤子怎么样？ (Nǐ juéde zhè tiáo kùzi zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of these pants?
我记得你已经有两条这样的裤子了。 (Wǒ jìde nǐ yǐjīng yǒu liǎng tiáo zhèyàng de kùzi le.) - I remember you already have two pairs of pants like this.
那我们再看看别的。 (Nà wǒmen zài kànkan biéde.) - Then let's look at others.
这件衬衫怎么样？ (Zhè jiàn chènshān zěnmeyàng?) - How about this shirt?
还不错，多少钱？ (Hái búcuò, duōshao qián?) - Not bad; how much is it?
这上面写着320元。 (Zhè shàngmian xiězhe sān bǎi èrshí yuán.) - It says 320 yuan on it.
买一件。 (Mǎi yí jiàn.) - Buy one.
Dialogue 3: 在水果店 (In a fruit store)
这些水果真新鲜，我们买西瓜还是苹果？ (Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ zhēn xīnxiān, wǒmen mǎi xīguā háishi píngguǒ?) - These fruits are really fresh; shall we buy watermelon or apples?
西瓜吧。 (Xīguā ba.) - Watermelon.
你看，这上面写着“西瓜不甜不要钱”。 (Nǐ kàn, zhè shàngmian xiězhe “xīguā bù tián bú yào qián”.) - Look, it says on it "if the watermelon is not sweet, it's free".
那我们买一个大点儿的吧。 (Nà wǒmen mǎi yí ge dà diǎnr de ba.) - Then let's buy a bigger one.
再买几个苹果。 (Zài mǎi jǐ ge píngguǒ.) - Buy a few apples too.
好啊，今天晚上只吃水果不吃饭！ (Hǎo a, jīntiān wǎnshang zhǐ chī shuǐguǒ bù chī fàn!) - OK, tonight we'll only eat fruit and not eat a meal!
Dialogue 4: 在休息室 (In the lounge)
桌子上放着很多饮料，你喝什么？ (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào, nǐ hē shénme?) - There are lots of drinks on the table; what will you have?
茶或者咖啡都可以。 (Chá huòzhě kāfēi dōu kěyǐ.) - Tea or coffee, either is fine.
你呢？你喝什么？ (Nǐ ne? Nǐ hē shénme?) - And you? What will you drink?
我喝茶，茶是我的最爱。 (Wǒ hē chá, chá shì wǒ de zuì ài.) - I'll drink tea; tea is my favourite.

天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶会很舒服。 (Tiān lěngle huòzhě gōngzuò lèile de shíhou, hē bēi rè chá huì hěn shūfu.) - When the weather turns cold or when work has made me tired, a cup of hot tea feels very comfortable.
你喜欢喝什么茶？ (Nǐ xǐhuan hē shénme chá?) - What kind of tea do you like to drink?
花茶、绿茶、红茶，我都喜欢。 (Huāchá, lǜchá, hóngchá, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.) - Flower tea, green tea, black tea - I like them all.
你要喝咖啡还是喝茶？ (Nǐ yào hē kāfēi háishi hē chá?) - Do you want to drink coffee or tea?
明天是晴天还是阴天？ (Míngtiān shì qíngtiān háishi yīntiān?) - Will tomorrow be sunny or cloudy?
今天晚上吃米饭或者面条都可以。 (Jīntiān wǎnshang chī mǐfàn huòzhě miàntiáo dōu kěyǐ.) - Tonight either rice or noodles is fine.
天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶很舒服。 (Tiān lěng le huòzhě gōngzuò lèi le de shíhou, hē bēi rè chá hěn shūfu.) - When the weather turns cold or when work has made you tired, a cup of hot tea is very comfortable.
周太太40岁还是50岁，我们不知道。 (Zhōu tàitai sìshí suì háishi wǔshí suì, wǒmen bù zhīdào.) - We don't know whether Mrs. Zhou is 40 or 50.
小丽还没想好周末去爬山还是去看电影。 (Xiǎolì hái méi xiǎnghǎo zhōumò qù pá shān háishi qù kàn diànyǐng.) - Xiaoli hasn't decided yet whether to climb a mountain or watch a film at the weekend.
他的生日是10月还是11月，我不记得了。 (Tā de shēngrì shì shí yuè háishi shíyī yuè, wǒ bú jìde le.) - I don't remember whether his birthday is in October or November.
我不知道这个人是男的还是女的。 (Wǒ bù zhīdào zhège rén shì nán de háishi nǚ de.) - I don't know whether this person is male or female.
桌子上放着一杯咖啡。 (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe yì bēi kāfēi.) - There is a cup of coffee on the table.
我家楼上住着一个老师。 (Wǒ jiā lóu shàng zhùzhe yí ge lǎoshī.) - A teacher lives upstairs from my home.
上面写着320元。 (Shàngmian xiězhe sān bǎi èrshí yuán.) - It says 320 yuan on it.
桌子上放着很多饮料。 (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào.) - There are plenty of drinks on the table.
桌子上没放着咖啡。 (Zhuōzi shang méi fàngzhe kāfēi.) - There is no coffee on the table.
我家楼上没住着老师。 (Wǒ jiā lóu shàng méi zhùzhe lǎoshī.) - No teacher lives upstairs from my home.
上面没写着多少钱。 (Shàngmian méi xiězhe duōshao qián.) - It doesn't say how much it costs on it.
桌子上没放着饮料。 (Zhuōzi shang méi fàngzhe yǐnliào.) - There are no drinks on the table.
你穿得那么少，会感冒的。 (Nǐ chuān de nàme shǎo, huì gǎnmào de.) - You are dressed so lightly; you will catch a cold.
别担心，我会照顾好自己。 (Bié dānxīn, wǒ huì zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.) - Don't worry; I will take good care of myself.
你不给他打电话吗，他会不高兴的。 (Nǐ bù gěi tā dǎ diànhuà ma, tā huì bù gāoxìng de.) - Aren't you going to call him? He will be unhappy.
喝杯热茶会很舒服。 (Hē bēi rè chá huì hěn shūfu.) - Drinking a cup of hot tea will feel very comfortable.
你还记得我吗？ (Nǐ hái jìde wǒ ma?) - Do you still remember me?
我记得你已经有两条这样的裤子了。 (Wǒ jìde nǐ yǐjīng yǒu liǎng tiáo zhèyàng de kùzi le.) - I remember you already have two pairs of pants like this.
这些水果真新鲜。 (Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ zhēn xīnxiān.) - These fruits are really fresh.
桌子上放着很多饮料。 (Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào.) - There are plenty of drinks on the table.
这儿只卖书，不卖水。 (Zhèr zhǐ mài shū, bú mài shuǐ.) - Only books are sold here, not water.
今天晚上只吃水果不吃饭。 (Jīntiān wǎnshang zhǐ chī shuǐguǒ bù chī fàn.) - Tonight I'll only eat fruit and not eat a meal.
你觉得这条裤子怎么样？ (Nǐ juéde zhè tiáo kùzi zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of these pants?
去年8月。 (Qùnián bā yuè.) - Last August.
你跟我一起出去走走吧。 (Nǐ gēn wǒ yìqǐ chūqù zǒuzou ba.) - Come out for a walk with me.
谢谢你，再见。 (Xièxie nǐ, zàijiàn.) - Thank you, goodbye.
上个周末你去哪儿了？ (Shàng ge zhōumò nǐ qù nǎr le?) - Where did you go last weekend?
你想什么呢？ (Nǐ xiǎng shénme ne?) - What are you thinking about?
那我吃水果吧。 (Nà wǒ chī shuǐguǒ ba.) - Then I'll eat fruit.
我们什么时候去上海？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou qù Shànghǎi?) - When are we going to Shanghai?
你看看机票。 (Nǐ kànkan jīpiào.) - Take a look at the plane ticket.
那就是后天。 (Nà jiùshì hòutiān.) - Then that's the day after tomorrow.
我的笔呢？ (Wǒ de bǐ ne?) - Where is my pen?
你看见了吗？ (Nǐ kànjiàn le ma?) - Have you seen it?
红的那个。 (Hóng de nàge.) - The red one.
不，只有两个学生。 (Bù, zhǐ yǒu liǎng ge xuésheng.) - No, there are only two students.
明天小刚去做什么？ (Míngtiān Xiǎogāng qù zuò shénme?) - What is Xiaogang going to do tomorrow?
小丽也去吗？ (Xiǎolì yě qù ma?) - Is Xiaoli going too?
周太太买裤子了吗？ (Zhōu tàitai mǎi kùzi le ma?) - Did Mrs. Zhou buy pants?
周太太买什么了？ (Zhōu tàitai mǎi shénme le?) - What did Mrs. Zhou buy?
周明和太太买了什么水果？ (Zhōu Míng hé tàitai mǎile shénme shuǐguǒ?) - What fruit did Zhou Ming and his wife buy?
小刚喜欢喝什么？ (Xiǎogāng xǐhuan hē shénme?) - What does Xiaogang like to drink?
小丽喜欢喝什么？ (Xiǎolì xǐhuan hē shénme?) - What does Xiaoli like to drink?
你喜欢早睡早起还是晚睡晚起？ (Nǐ xǐhuan zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ háishi wǎn shuì wǎn qǐ?) - Do you like going to bed early and getting up early, or going to bed late and getting up late?
早饭你常喝咖啡还是牛奶？ (Zǎofàn nǐ cháng hē kāfēi háishi niúnǎi?) - For breakfast do you often drink coffee or milk?
你喜欢走路还是坐车？ (Nǐ xǐhuan zǒulù háishi zuò chē?) - Do you prefer walking or going by vehicle?
你喜欢晴天还是雨天？ (Nǐ xǐhuan qíngtiān háishi yǔtiān?) - Do you like sunny days or rainy days?
你喜欢看电视还是看电影？ (Nǐ xǐhuan kàn diànshì háishi kàn diànyǐng?) - Do you like watching TV or watching films?
你喜欢饭前吃水果还是饭后吃水果？ (Nǐ xǐhuan fàn qián chī shuǐguǒ háishi fàn hòu chī shuǐguǒ?) - Do you like eating fruit before meals or after meals?
我的房间里放着一张桌子。 (Wǒ de fángjiān li fàngzhe yì zhāng zhuōzi.) - There is a table in my room.
茶好客常来。 (Chá hǎo kè cháng lái.) - Good tea attracts frequenters.
“茶好客常来”的意思是，如果茶很好喝，客人就会经常来。 (“Chá hǎo kè cháng lái” de yìsi shì, rúguǒ chá hěn hǎohē, kèrén jiù huì jīngcháng lái.) - "茶好客常来" means that if the tea is very good, guests will often come.

这句话常用来比喻只要东西好，顾客就会喜欢。 (Zhè jù huà cháng yòng lái bǐyù zhǐyào dōngxi hǎo, gùkè jiù huì xǐhuan.) - This saying is often used metaphorically to mean that as long as something is good, customers will like it.
她总是笑着跟客人说话。 (Tā zǒngshì xiàozhe gēn kèrén shuōhuà.) - She always smiles when talking to customers.
Dialogue 1: 在教室 (In the classroom)
这是你们比赛的照片吗？ (Zhè shì nǐmen bǐsài de zhàopiàn ma?) - Is this a photo of your match?
是，这是我们比赛后照的。 (Shì, zhè shì wǒmen bǐsài hòu zhào de.) - Yes, this was taken after our match.
照得不错，你们都是一个年级的吗？ (Zhào de búcuò, nǐmen dōu shì yí ge niánjí de ma?) - It's well taken. Are you all in the same grade?
不是。 (Bú shì.) - No.
那个又高又漂亮的女孩儿是二年级的。 (Nàge yòu gāo yòu piàoliang de nǚháir shì èr niánjí de.) - That tall and pretty girl is in the second grade.
旁边那个拿着书笑的人是谁？ (Pángbiān nàge názhe shū xiào de rén shì shéi?) - Who is the person next to her, holding a book and smiling?
那是我！ (Nà shì wǒ!) - That's me!
Dialogue 2: 在教室 (In the classroom)
你觉得小红怎么样？ (Nǐ juéde Xiǎohóng zěnmeyàng?) - What do you think of Xiaohong?
她又聪明又热情，也很努力。 (Tā yòu cōngming yòu rèqíng, yě hěn nǔlì.) - She is both clever and warm, and works hard too.
我看她总是笑着回答老师的问题。 (Wǒ kàn tā zǒngshì xiàozhe huídá lǎoshī de wèntí.) - I see that she always answers the teacher's questions with a smile.
她对每个人都笑，也常常对我笑。 (Tā duì měi ge rén dōu xiào, yě chángcháng duì wǒ xiào.) - She smiles at everyone and often smiles at me too.
你是不是喜欢她啊？ (Nǐ shì bu shì xǐhuan tā a?) - Do you like her?

喜欢她的人太多了，你看那些拿着鲜花站在门口的，都是等她的。 (Xǐhuan tā de rén tài duō le, nǐ kàn nàxiē názhe xiānhuā zhàn zài ménkǒu de, dōu shì děng tā de.) - There are too many people who like her; look at those standing at the door holding fresh flowers - they are all waiting for her.
Dialogue 3: 在超市门口 (At the entrance of a supermarket)
我有点儿饿了，我们进超市买点儿东西吧。 (Wǒ yǒudiǎnr è le, wǒmen jìn chāoshì mǎi diǎnr dōngxi ba.) - I'm a bit hungry; let's go into the supermarket and buy something.

好啊，这家超市的蛋糕又便宜又好吃，一块只要2.99元。 (Hǎo a, zhè jiā chāoshì de dàngāo yòu piányi yòu hǎochī, yí kuàir zhǐ yào èr diǎn jiǔ jiǔ yuán.) - OK; the cakes in this supermarket are both cheap and tasty - only 2.99 yuan a piece.
我们买两块，回家吃着蛋糕看电视，怎么样？ (Wǒmen mǎi liǎng kuàir, huí jiā chīzhe dàngāo kàn diànshì, zěnmeyàng?) - Let's buy two pieces and eat cake while watching TV at home - how about that?
好啊，我再去买一些喝的。 (Hǎo a, wǒ zài qù mǎi yìxiē hē de.) - OK, I'll go and buy something to drink too.
喝着咖啡吃蛋糕，太好了！ (Hēzhe kāfēi chī dàngāo, tài hǎo le!) - Eating cake while drinking coffee - great!
Dialogue 4: 在饭馆 (In a restaurant)
您好！您找谁？ (Nín hǎo! Nín zhǎo shéi?) - Hello! Who are you looking for?
你们这儿是不是有一个又年轻又漂亮的服务员？ (Nǐmen zhèr shì bu shì yǒu yí ge yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang de fúwùyuán?) - Do you have a waitress here who is both young and pretty?
我们这儿年轻、漂亮的服务员有很多。 (Wǒmen zhèr niánqīng, piàoliang de fúwùyuán yǒu hěn duō.) - We have many young, pretty waitresses here.
她工作又认真又热情。 (Tā gōngzuò yòu rènzhēn yòu rèqíng.) - She works both earnestly and warmly.
您能再说说吗？ (Nín néng zài shuōshuo ma?) - Could you tell me a little more?
她总是笑着跟客人说话。 (Tā zǒngshì xiàozhe gēn kèrén shuōhuà.) - She always smiles when talking to customers.
啊，我知道了，你说的是李小美吧？ (À, wǒ zhīdào le, nǐ shuō de shì Lǐ Xiǎoměi ba?) - Ah, I know now - you mean Li Xiaomei, right?
